messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our adjusted Angebot stands at a price of €33.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.70 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

However, to ensure reliable supply under our current plant utilization, the lead time must remain at 54 days. Please note that we do not provide internal cost breakdowns as a matter of corporate policy. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation (2)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your acceptance of a 56-day lead time and the binding volume of 23,400 units over 24 months. In response to these terms, we adjust our price to €31.50 per unit. 

For clarity, our offer stands at a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This is valid for 7 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Regarding your query, which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
